exposure: uterine artery pseudoaneurysm after caesarean section
cohort: A 28-year-old woman who developed secondary postpartum haemorrhage due to uterine artery pseudoaneurysm following a caesarean section.
finding: Angiographic embolisation is a safe and effective procedure for treating postpartum haemorrhage resulting from uterine artery pseudoaneurysm in haemodynamically stable patients, whereas uterine artery ligation may be preferred for unstable patients when fertility preservation is desired.
mod_finding: The uterine artery pseudoaneurysm and secondary postpartum haemorrhage were complications that occurred after caesarean section.
